title: polyDegreeLt is closed under polyAdd at the same bound
statement: If polyDegreeLt c n and polyDegreeLt g n then polyDegreeLt (polyAdd c g) n -- the degree bound is preserved (not merely bounded by the max) when both summands already share the same bound n.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.polyDegreeLt_polyAdd : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> CReal)) -> ((x1 : ((x1 : AxNat) -> CReal)) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : CReal.polyDegreeLt x0 x2) -> ((x4 : CReal.polyDegreeLt x1 x2) -> CReal.polyDegreeLt (CReal.polyAdd x0 x1) x2)))))

evidence.supports: CReal.polyDegreeLt_polyAdd is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
